in_sanskrit.name: Ratilal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings joy and pleasure, and is also red

in_hindi.name: रतिलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो रति (joy, pleasure) और लल (red) है

in_marathi.name: Ratilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ratilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rati is the goddess of love, and Lilam means chariot. So Ratilal means 'Lord of the Chariot of Love'.

in_bengali.name: Ratilal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Chariot
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ratilal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rati is the goddess of love, and Lilam means chariot. So Ratilal means 'Lord of the Chariot of Love'.
